```yaml
name: Release to Maven Central & Docker Hub

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Run in dry-run mode (build only, no publishing)'
        required: false
        default: false
        type: boolean

env:
  MAVEN_VERSION: "3.9.6"
  JAVA_VERSION: "17"

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    concurrency:
      group: release-${{ github.ref }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.RELEASE_TOKEN || github.token }}

      - name: Validate secrets
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_USERNAME }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.SONATYPE_PASSWORD }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}" ]] || [[ -z "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" ]]; then
            echo "Missing required secrets"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          java-version: ${{ env.JAVA_VERSION }}
          distribution: 'temurin'

      - name: Setup Maven
        uses: stCarolas/setup-maven@v5
        with:
          maven-version: ${{ env.MAVEN_VERSION }}

      - name: Import GPG key
        uses: crazy-max/ghaction-import-gpg@v6
        with:
          gpg_private_key: ${{ secrets.GPG_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          passphrase: ${{ secrets.GPG_PASSPHRASE }}

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Login to DockerHub
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          username: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Determine next version
        id: version
        run: |
          # Get current version from pom.xml
          CURRENT_VERSION=$(mvn help:effective-pom -Doutput=/tmp/effective-pom.xml -q && grep '<version>' /tmp/effective-pom.xml | head -1 | sed 's/.*<version>\(.*\)<\/version>.*/\1/')
          echo "current_version=$CURRENT_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          
          # For pre-1.0.0-GA, increment minor version
          IFS='.' read -ra VERSION_PARTS <<< "$CURRENT_VERSION"
          MAJOR="${VERSION_PARTS[0]}"
          MINOR="${VERSION_PARTS[1]}"
          PATCH="${VERSION_PARTS[2]}"
          
          if [[ "$MAJOR" == "0" ]]; then
            NEW_MINOR=$((MINOR + 1))
            NEW_VERSION="0.${NEW_MINOR}.0"
          else
            NEW_VERSION="$CURRENT_VERSION"
          fi
          
          echo "new_version=$NEW_VERSION" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Prepare release
        run: |
          mvn versions:set -DnewVersion=${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }} -DgenerateBackupPoms=false
          git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
          git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
          git add pom.xml ojp-server/pom.xml
          git commit -m "Release version ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Build and test
        run: |
          mvn clean verify -Prelease

      - name: Publish to Maven Central
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry-run }}
        run: |
          mvn deploy -Prelease -DskipTests

      - name: Build and push Docker image
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry-run }}
        run: |
          mvn compile jib:build -Djib.to.image=rrobetti/ojp:${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }} -Djib.to.auth.username=${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_USER }} -Djib.to.auth.password=${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Update documentation
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry-run }}
        run: |
          # Find all markdown files
          find . -name "*.md" -type f | while read -r file; do
            # Replace version references
            sed -i "s/rrobetti\/ojp:[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+/rrobetti\/ojp:${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}/g" "$file"
            sed -i "s/ojp-server-[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.jar/ojp-server-${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}.jar/g" "$file"
            sed -i "s/groupId>com\.openjproxy<\/groupId>/groupId>com.openjproxy<\/groupId>/g" "$file"
            sed -i "s/artifactId>ojp-server<\/artifactId>/artifactId>ojp-server<\/artifactId>/g" "$file"
            sed -i "s/version>[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+\.[0-9]\+</version>${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}</g" "$file"
          done
          
          # Commit documentation updates
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update documentation for release ${{ steps.version.outputs.new_version }}" || echo "No documentation changes to commit"

      - name: Push release commit
        if: ${{ !inputs.dry-run }}
        run: |
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
